title: LCARS Reserved Seat
description: A RESERVED seat in the role catalogue (BL-6-45): the seat claims the provisioning identity (forge account + token, via the four-list equality check) and its role_index slot, but is NOT spawnable — kind discriminates at every consumer (Image branches validation, list/ filters, load refuses {:role_reserved, name}). STRICT like the profile schema: a seat carrying a `spec` is REJECTED — a spec for a role that cannot spawn would be an invented inventory.
